comments:
**qa — done — 2026-11-03**

Produced: acme/acm-211-snooze-a-reminder@seed

Codified 2 cases, both green. One blocking ambiguity routes this back to the architect.

**Findings**
- AMB-1 — test-plan.md (blocking AMB) — "A snooze takes effect and ends by itself" — ambiguity → architect: the contract says what a snooze does on an open reminder and nothing about one that is already snoozed. The spec says people open the full list mostly to snooze a reminder again. Readings: the new instant replaces the old one; the request is rejected; only a later instant is accepted.
